152:     def _quarantine(self, record, reason):
153:         # Caller holds _lock. Keep protection/permit/owner references alive.
154:         record.phase = Phase.QUARANTINED
155:         record.reason = reason
156:         record.quarantine_persisted = False
157:         if record.owner is not None:
158:             record.owner._revoked = True
159:         try:
160:             recorded = self._kernel.quarantine(record.key, record.protection, record.permit, reason)
161:         except BaseException as exc:
162:             record.quarantine_failure_type = type(exc).__name__
163:             if not isinstance(exc, Exception):
164:                 raise
165:             raise CleanupUnconfirmed("Quarantine persistence is unconfirmed; local record remains blocked") from exc
166:         if recorded is not True:
167:             record.quarantine_failure_type = "UnconfirmedReturn"
168:             raise CleanupUnconfirmed("Quarantine persistence is unconfirmed; local record remains blocked")
169:         record.quarantine_persisted = True
170:         record.quarantine_failure_type = None
